caption:
can your pillow give you wrinkles?

Some lines, yes. Lines from smiling and frowning follow how your face moves. Lines from sleeping on your side or stomach come from your face being pressed and folded — a 2016 review in Aesthetic Surgery Journal separates the two by cause, location and pattern. Sleep lines often run across expression lines rather than along them.

Quick check: look at the side you sleep on. If the lines are deeper there, or cut across your smile lines, your pillow is likely part of it.

A morning crease usually fades. The same fold, night after night, is what can leave a line.

Skin Test #15/30 from a doctor in Seoul. Follow for #16: that brown patch might not be a sun spot.
